subject: Renewal: NewScale - renewal terms, credit smoothing & onboarding ops
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: NewScale Procurement <procurement@newscale.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <arivera@newscale.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal placeholder and ops checklist

Hi Alex / NewScale procurement team,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. Per our roadmap, your current retainer converts on 2028-08-01 — I wanted to open the thread for the renewal and a proposed structure that balances a modest rate hold for the first 6 months while we add the new inference pools you requested.

High-level proposal (attachment: redwood-pricing-table.xlsx):
- 12-month renewal, commit increased by 25% (covering new QA and staging capacity)
- 6-month price hold (same unit price as today) then step-down to the new tiered rates
- A smoothing credit equal to 15% of the incremental commit amortized across first three invoices to offset migration uplift

Operational asks from our side:
- Signed SOW (draft attached: NewScale_SOW_v3.pdf) by 2028-07-15 to secure deployment windows
- PO or DocuSign by 2028-07-25 to avoid billing overlap
- Technical kick-off: preferred week of 2028-07-30 (we'll send an ops checklist)

If that all sounds reasonable, I can loop in pricing ops and legal for a compact addendum.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0177

---
Attachments: redwood-pricing-table.xlsx (spreadsheet), NewScale_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW draft)
From: Alex Rivera <arivera@newscale.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: NewScale Procurement <procurement@newscale.com>, Lisa Mendez <lisa.mendez@newscale.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal placeholder and ops checklist

Jonas — thanks for the proposal and the quick turnaround on the SOW. A few clarifying questions from procurement and finance: 

1) The smoothing credit: can that be structured as a refundable credit that applies if usage does not increase to the committed uplift after quarter 1? Finance is cautious about credits that aren't tethered to realized consumption.
2) The 6-month price hold is fine, but we want a written assurance that the priority capacity windows for staging are guaranteed (we cannot afford a go-live delay due to GPU allocation).
3) Are there any items in the SOW that will trigger one-time professional services fees? We would prefer to roll most of the migration support into the commit if possible.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call Wednesday (2028-07-04) to run through these items?

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Cloud Platform, NewScale
arivera@newscale.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <arivera@newscale.com>
Cc: NewScale Procurement <procurement@newscale.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal placeholder and ops checklist

Alex — great questions. Quick answers before our call: 

1) Smoothing credit mechanics: we can structure it as a conditional credit that amortizes across invoices but with a clawback if usage stays below 70% of the uplifted commit after 90 days. If you prefer an escrow-like holdback instead of clawback, we can do that as well — I'll include both options in the redline.
2) Capacity windows: we will reserve a set of burst slots for your go-live week (as an SLA attachment). I included Ben from capacity (cc'd) to confirm pool reservation mechanics.
3) Professional services: current SOW includes a 40-hour onboarding block rolled into the commit; there is an optional migration sprint line item. We can absorb the migration sprint into the first-month invoice as a one-time credit if that helps procurement sign-off.

I'll bring a concise term addendum to the call that highlights the price hold language, the credit structure options, and the capacity reservation SLA. Marissa — can you weigh in on the credit escrow vs. clawback option from a commercial perspective?

Call link: https://meet.redwood.com/ns-renewal-0704

Thanks,
Jonas

> On Mon, Jul 2, 2028 at 10:12 AM Alex Rivera <arivera@newscale.com> wrote:
> > Jonas — thanks for the proposal and the quick turnaround on the SOW...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: NewScale Procurement <procurement@newscale.com>, Alex Rivera <arivera@newscale.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Jul 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal placeholder and ops checklist — commercial stance

Jonas / Ben / NewScale team — after reviewing the numbers and the ask to absorb migration support, here's our recommended commercial stance: 

- Approve a 12-month commitment with a 25% uplift.
- Offer the 6-month price hold at the current unit price.
- Structure the 15% smoothing credit as an escrow held by Redwood for up to 90 days; if post-migration uplift < 70% of the committed increase we apply a pro-rata clawback. This balances NewScale's desire for a refundable-looking credit with Redwood's need to limit credit exposure.
- Migration sprint: we will include a one-time 50% discount on the optional migration sprint if NewScale signs SOW v3 by 2028-07-15; otherwise migration is billable at standard PS rates.

Ben — please confirm that the reserved burst slots can be guaranteed for the week of go-live (we will publish an SLA addendum).

Alex / procurement — if you can confirm acceptance of the escrow + clawback mechanics we will prepare a short term addendum and a DocuSign for signature. Our legal team will keep the addendum tight to avoid PO delays.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercials — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, NewScale Procurement <procurement@newscale.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <arivera@newscale.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal placeholder and ops checklist — capacity confirmation

Marissa / Jonas / Alex — confirmed. We can reserve the required burst pool for the go-live week (2028-08-01 through 2028-08-07) and will include a clause in the SLA addendum guaranteeing replacement capacity in the rare event of hardware failure (replacement within 4 hours or credit compensation).

Next steps:
- Marissa to send the term addendum + DocuSign (target: today).
- Jonas to circulate the final SOW v3 with PS discount applied if NewScale signs by 2028-07-15.
- Alex to confirm procurement acceptance of the escrow + clawback wording and send PO/DocuSign.

Thanks — Ben
